content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early 2023, showing upward bias despite sentiment indicating caution.", "Sentiment spikes near 1.00 often precede sharp price reversals, suggesting model overconfidence in bullish signals.", "Model forecasts in 2022-11 show strong mean-reversion patterns, with prices quickly correcting after initial upward momentum.", "Forecast lags in 2023-11 correlate with sentiment shifts, indicating delayed reaction to market sentiment changes.", "Models exhibit significant overshoot in 2022-11, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative, leading to overvalued predictions.", "Sentiment history with multiple 0.00 values indicates market uncertainty, which models often misinterpret as stable, causing underestimation.", "Forecast accuracy improves when sentiment and price history show consistent downward trends, suggesting model calibration is needed for bearish signals.", "Models fail to capture volatility spikes when sentiment is mixed, leading to underestimation of price swings in 2023-11."]}
